title: refactor(plugin-auth): move AuthManager's plugin assembly helpers into auth-manager-plugin-assembly.ts (#25224 cut 6)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-sales"} -->
_Requested by **Sales** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4Uu?thread=cmsg_01D5bWFY3rFzgJcytD5gD4UuMjbPDrsigsyqoKsV4WZQMz)_

Part of #25224
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none
Ruling-ref: 6348891160

The basis for the `Clause-②: no` line: this is a move. No accept set, export, route, refusal, code or answer changes. The `.d.ts` bar is ruling `6348891160` item 1 (on #25222, covering this card). `@objectstack/plugin-auth`'s published `dist/index.d.ts` and `dist/index.d.mts` are raw byte-identical to base (0 diff lines, so the union-order normalisation has nothing to do), with the ruling's positive control. Its entry exports the same 155 names under ESM and CJS (measured below).

Cut 6 of the `auth-manager.ts` split: **the plugin assembly helpers.** Three `AuthManager` method bodies (85 lines) move unedited, re-indented one level, into one new module, `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-manager-plugin-assembly.ts`. #25224 stays open for the later cuts.

This follows the amended claim `6361212912`, which amends `6359424739` on the file cut 5 left (#25395, landed note `6360455119`). The shape is cuts 1 to 5's, which is #23050's.

Branch: `claude/project-thread-lg3wrj`, the harness-pinned branch for this session, restarted from `origin/main` `eca6b61922` after #25395 merged. It names no issue, so the card relation is this body's first line.

`auth-manager.ts` goes from 8,968 to 8,916 lines. The cut is +202 / −89 over 2 files: 291 changed lines, under the 3,000-line line. It is not a governed surface (`check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: 0 of the 2 paths hit the register).

## Why this seam

These are the three helpers `buildPluginList` calls to assemble better-auth's plugins:
- `addOptionalPlugin`: one optional plugin whose construction throws is skipped, recorded in `degradedFeatures` and logged, so it cannot take down core email/password and session auth (the 15.1.0 incident its docblock records);
- `buildJwtPlugin`: the `jwt` plugin, built with a signing algorithm this host can use (the Ed25519 probe), the signing-key reader, and the `/get-session` header hook made non-fatal;
- `reportJwtSigningFailure`: the record and once-per-build announcement of a JWT signing failure that hook catches.

What stays, and why:
- `resolvePasswordHasher` stays. Its body reads `isWebContainerRuntime`, a module-level function that `auth-manager.ts` does not export and that `installWebContainerRequestStatePolyfill` also reads. `index.ts` re-exports `auth-manager.ts` whole (`export * from './auth-manager.js'`), so exporting it there would publish it, and moving it would move a declaration the polyfill shares. Per the landed note `6360455119`, a body that reads an unexported module helper comes back as `needs_decision` before it is cut.
- `getDegradedAuthFeatures` stays: it is the public, one-line read of the record `addOptionalPlugin` writes.
- `buildPluginList`, which calls all three, is a later cut.
- `createDatabaseConfig`, `resolveAuthSecret` and `generateSecret` are the database and secret `createAuthInstance` hands better-auth, a different area, so they take their own cut. The seat agreed both splits.

## What moved

| method | base signature line | body lines | members it reads |
|---|---:|---:|---|
| `addOptionalPlugin` | `:3178` | 15 | `degradedFeatures` |
| `buildJwtPlugin` | `:3242` | 55 | `config`, `ed25519ProbeResult` (read and written), `reportJwtSigningFailure` |
| `reportJwtSigningFailure` | `:3308` | 15 | `degradedFeatures`, `jwtSigningFailureReported` (read and written) |

Lines are base `eca6b61922`. The members come from a walk of every `this.X` in each body with the TypeScript compiler API. No body has a bare `this`, `this[...]`, `arguments` or `super`, or a `this` inside a `function` or a nested class. No body reads a static (`AuthManager.X`) or a module-level declaration of `auth-manager.ts`. The two assignments to a `this` member are `buildJwtPlugin`'s to `ed25519ProbeResult` and `reportJwtSigningFailure`'s to `jwtSigningFailureReported`.

**Imports.** Six imported names are read only by the moved text, so they leave `auth-manager.ts` and the new module imports each from the same place:
- `buildJwtPluginSchema` (`./auth-schema-config.js`, still imported by `auth-manager.ts` for ten other names);
- `createSigningKeyReader` (`./signing-key-read-cache.js`, still imported there for `retireHeldKeyrings` and `UNKNOWN_SIGNING_KEY_REREAD_FLOOR_MS`);
- `createHostUsableJwksReader`, `probeEd25519Support`, `protectGetSessionJwtHook` and `resolveJwtSigningAlgorithm` (`./jwt-key-algorithm.js`).

**Evaluation order.** `auth-manager.ts` no longer imports `./jwt-key-algorithm.js` itself. Nothing observable moves: that module has no imports, and its top level is three `as const` object literals, a type alias, interfaces and function declarations, so the point at which it is evaluated cannot be observed. `signing-key-read-cache.ts` imports it type-only.

## The shape

- **The class keeps all three methods** at their places, with their names, signatures and docblocks: the published `.d.ts` lists each one. Each body is now a host literal of exactly the members that body reads, typed as a `Pick` of `PluginAssemblyHost`, plus `.call`.
- **`PluginAssemblyHost`** lives in the new module. It names the 5 members the bodies read, each typed as the class member (`AuthManager['degradedFeatures']`, …). The module imports `AuthManager` as a type only, so there is no runtime cycle.
- **`reportJwtSigningFailure` goes as a late-bound closure** (`(...a) => this.reportJwtSigningFailure(...a)`). The `/get-session` guard calls it at request time, long after `buildJwtPlugin` returned, and still reaches the method on the manager, so a spy or double set there is still the one it reaches.
- **`config` and `degradedFeatures` go as getters.** The class reassigns `config` after construction (`setRuntimeBaseUrl`, `applyConfigPatch`), so it is read off the manager when a body reads it, as before. `degradedFeatures` is read the same way.
- **`ed25519ProbeResult` and `jwtSigningFailureReported` go as get/set pairs.** The bodies store to both on the manager. So the Ed25519 probe still runs once per manager, the `() => this.ed25519ProbeResult!` thunk still reads the manager's promise when better-auth calls it, and a signing failure is still announced once per plugin-list build, which resets the flag (`buildPluginList`, which stays).
- **Two stubs are no longer `async`.** Each returns the moved async function's own promise, so a caller awaits the same promise the body settles. Building the host cannot throw, so no method now throws synchronously where it used to reject. `reportJwtSigningFailure` was synchronous and stays so.
- **The cost:** one small host object per call. `buildJwtPlugin` and `addOptionalPlugin` run once per plugin-list build; `reportJwtSigningFailure` runs only on a signing failure.
- **Nothing re-exports the new module**, so the published surface does not move.

## Path readers

None needs migrating: no reader keys on a moved line. Measured as reading no moved line:
- **`api-error-code.pin.test.ts`'s `authManagerFiles` floor**: no `new APIError(` sits in the moved bodies, so the floor reads the same sites over the same files at base and head, and the new module is not added to the list.
- **Plugin-factory scans** in `better-auth-schema-parity.test.ts` and `managed-extension-fields.test.ts`: the moved text has no `await import(`. `buildJwtPlugin` takes the `jwt` factory as a parameter, and the factory's import stays in `buildPluginList`.
- **`check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary.mjs`**, **`check-auth-mount-ledger.mjs`** and **`auth-manager-base-path.test.ts`**: none of the tokens they read sits in the moved text. `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary` reads 56 sites found and 56 classified at base and at head.
- **The tenant-audit census** and its two documents: the moved text holds no engine write. Compared per site, base and head read the same 237 sites with the same totals (below), so neither document is regenerated.
- **The system-context census**: the moved text holds no `isSystem` read. The census reads 148 elevation read sites at base and at head.
- **`scripts/adr-anchors/`**: the moved text cites no ADR, and no entry's invariant describes it. The `auth-manager.ts` entry (ADR-0093 and ADR-0108) is unchanged and still holds.
- **Callers through the manager**: the suites that drive the three methods, among them `auth-manager.jwt-eddsa-fallback.test.ts` (the host without Ed25519, an existing EdDSA key hidden and never deleted, and the signing failure recorded and announced once) and `auth-manager.optional-plugin-isolation.test.ts` (a throwing optional plugin skipped while sign-up and get-session still answer, and the degraded state reset on rebuild), call each through the class method. All pass at head (below).
- **Every symbol anchor into the file.** Before the cut, every `auth-manager.ts#symbol` anchor in the tracked tree outside changelogs was mapped with `symbolSegmentResolution` from `scripts/symbol-anchors.mjs`. There are 29, in ADR-0127, ADR-0134, ADR-0135 and four platform-checklist areas, and all 29 are `declaration`-class at base, with the 3 bodies blanked, and at head. None names a moved method. One names a token the moved text also carries: `#AuthManager` (ADR-0135), in the bodies' `[AuthManager]` log prefixes. It resolves on the class declaration, which stays.
- **`check-adr-anchors`' decision-letter layer** (the seat asks each cut's report for this count at both ends): 2,016 citations at base and 2,016 at head. The moved text carries no `ADR-NNNN Dk` citation, so nothing leaves the anchored surface. The number layer reads 52,116 citations across 6,623 files at both. On `origin/main` `7c68b10825` (below) the layer reads 2,014 alone and 2,014 with this cut.

## Proof

Builds and suites ran through `os-verify-lock`, and every exit code was captured before any pipe. Base `eca6b61922`, head `eda6277866`. A full `turbo run build` ran first. Then `plugin-auth` was built and its suite run at base, then built and run at head, on the same dependency dists.

**1. The moved text.**
- For each of the 3 methods, the base class body and the new module's function body are the same TypeScript token sequence (scanner tokens, kind and text, trivia skipped, each template literal re-scanned at its substitutions as the parser does).
- Every line is the base line minus exactly two leading spaces, and the parameters and return type are the same text.
- Each class method keeps its docblock and signature, with `async` dropped from the two that had it.
- Result: 3 of 3 pass, 85 body lines.

| method | body lines | tokens |
|---|---:|---:|
| `addOptionalPlugin` | 15 | 87 |
| `buildJwtPlugin` | 55 | 168 |
| `reportJwtSigningFailure` | 15 | 67 |

- **Negative control:** one token changed in the module (`'jwtSigning'` → `'jwtSigned'` in `reportJwtSigningFailure`) makes that method fail (tokens and lines DIFFER), and the run exits 1. Restored afterwards; `cmp` against the saved copy was clean.
- **An independent reading:** `git diff --color-moved=plain --color-moved-ws=allow-indentation-change eca6b61922 eda6277866` over the two source files marks 85 of the 89 deleted lines and 96 of the 202 added lines as moved.
  - The other 4 deleted lines are the two `async` signature lines and two import-name lines (`buildJwtPluginSchema`, `createSigningKeyReader`). The `./jwt-key-algorithm.js` import block is marked moved: the module carries it verbatim.
  - The other added lines are the stubs' host literals, `PluginAssemblyHost`, the module header, the per-function pointer docblocks and the import blocks.

**2. `.d.ts` and exports (ruling `6348891160` items 1 and 2).**

| file | raw base | raw head | raw diff lines | normalised base | normalised head |
|---|---|---|---:|---|---|
| `dist/index.d.ts` | `3b3aedb6551d6324c40d87afd1cdee50b23bcb2c3384c39a9f71b771deca0472` | `3b3aedb6551d6324c40d87afd1cdee50b23bcb2c3384c39a9f71b771deca0472` | 0 | `d4a901d16c32f4838c14dd7fdc52d88d9d446b4b1d44afd4012c81b365ef9783` | `d4a901d16c32f4838c14dd7fdc52d88d9d446b4b1d44afd4012c81b365ef9783` |
| `dist/index.d.mts` | `e2cdb2bc530cc6a554107866875910a90031e42fc89574d9adcb00d38a1becf1` | `e2cdb2bc530cc6a554107866875910a90031e42fc89574d9adcb00d38a1becf1` | 0 | `b2c585e677d5ac57274c22d746f6213342fbf1e7c8061b56b94175e8fe21c19d` | `b2c585e677d5ac57274c22d746f6213342fbf1e7c8061b56b94175e8fe21c19d` |

- The normaliser, verbatim (the ruling's one-liner): `node -e 'const s=require("fs").readFileSync(process.argv[1],"utf8");process.stdout.write(s.replace(/"[^"\n]*"(?:\s*\|\s*"[^"\n]*")+/g,r=>r.split(/\s*\|\s*/).sort().join(" | ")))' dist/index.d.ts | sha256sum`.
- The raw files are already byte-identical, so no union-order swap occurs in this cut: items 1(b) and 1(d) hold with nothing to account for.
- **Positive control:** the head `dist/index.d.ts` with one private member made public (`private buildJwtPlugin;` → `buildJwtPlugin;`, line 1881, a one-line change) hashes raw `8eaebd38dabcfa33bbe0db93e6bd2c8836c91a169d81c8e6aa2ec4e78055b2de` and normalised `4c5bbc92792de5db2c8f1b89018fd45d4aea96fe43b7479e3c934db9069c6169`. Both differ from the readings above.
- **Export lists:** ESM `dist/index.mjs` and CJS `dist/index.js` each have 155 names at base and at head, the same list (the sha256 of the sorted names is `ed3ac8b902031d30…` on all four).
- **The bundle:** 20 files in `dist/` on both sides, the same list. Only `index.js`, `index.mjs`, their two `.map` files and the two build-input hash stamps differ, as a move of code inside the bundle must.

**3. Tests and lint.**
- `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=3` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth`: base `Test Files 187 passed (187)`, `Tests 3528 passed | 10 skipped (3538)`, VERDICT command-exit 0. Head: the same counts, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth typecheck` (both `tsc` projects and `check:test-typecheck`): exit 0.
- `eslint --no-inline-config` (the root `lint` script's binary and flags) over the 2 files: exit 0.

**4. The census and the anchors, at base and at head.**
- The tenant-audit census (`node scripts/tenant-audit-census.mjs --json`), compared per site with the new module's file name mapped back to `auth-manager.ts`: 237 sites on both sides, 0 per-site differences in object, verb, tenancy, context and elevation, 0 unresolved and 0 unledgered on both, and every total the same.
- These checkers were run by hand at base and at head, because `dispatch-gates` does not derive the ADR one. All six exit 0 at both, with the same reading at both:
  - `check-adr-symbol-anchors`: 2,384 anchors across 142 records, 466 symbol (440 declaration, 26 literal).
  - `check-adr-anchors`: 80 anchored files; the decision-letter layer as above.
  - `check-scripts-symbol-anchors` (4,061 anchors), `check-spec-docblock-symbol-anchors` (5,071 anchors, both read in the same built tree), `check-system-context-census` (148 elevation read sites) and `check-platform-checklist` (16 areas, 329 items).

**5. Gates.**
- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` derives 53 commands for the 2 paths. All 53 ran at `eda6277866` after the full build, and all 53 exited 0.
- `--ran`: 53 derived, 53 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED.
- `check-governed-merges.mjs --branch HEAD`: NOT governed, 291 changed lines.
- **Docs drift** (`node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json eca6b61922`, exit 0): 0 pages name something this change touched (11 anchors: 7 symbol, 4 literal).
- **Serial constraints** (in the claim): before the run, one open PR touched `auth-manager.ts`, #25398, in the docblock of the `enforceSessionControls` stub, not a line of this cut. It has since merged, with #25381, #25396 and #25397, and `origin/main` is `7c68b10825`. On that tree with this cut applied (no conflict):
  - the move proof against `7c68b10825` passes 3 of 3;
  - `check-tenant-audit-census`, `check-adr-anchors`, `check-adr-symbol-anchors`, `check-platform-checklist`, `check-system-context-census`, `check-auth-mount-ledger` and `check-dispatcher-error-vocabulary` exit 0;
  - the seven suites that drive the moved methods or read the file pass (386 tests).
- One open PR now touches `auth-manager.ts`: #25399, inside `createAuthInstance` and `buildPluginList`, not a line of this cut. `git merge-tree` of this head with #25399's head is clean.

## Changeset

None: `skip-changeset`, per ruling `6348891160` item 4. The published declarations and export lists are unchanged, and the bundle's bytes move only because code moved inside it.
